brief:
Israel has launched a new ground assault in Gaza, contradicting ceasefire arrangements, the Electronic Intifada reported. The operation marks a resumption of large-scale military operations in the territory following an earlier pause in hostilities.

The renewed offensive comes amid reports of violence elsewhere in the occupied territories. Israeli settlers killed a Palestinian grandmother inside her home near Jericho, according to the outlet.
dek: Israeli settlers murder Palestinian grandmother inside her home near Jericho.
title: Israeli forces launch new ground assault in Gaza amid ceasefire
